enriched.title: Verbos Irregulares e Vocabulário Diversificado
enriched.summary: A aula aborda verbos irregulares no passado, vocabulário relacionado a lugares, alimentos e atividades, além de frases de exemplo e expressões úteis para enriquecer o aprendizado.

vocabulary.definition: The lower part of a chicken's leg, often cooked and eaten.
examples: I ate a drumstick for lunch.
The drumstick is my favorite part of the chicken.

vocabulary.definition: A type of fish commonly used in culinary dishes.
examples: I bought codfish to prepare for dinner.
Codfish is popular during holidays in Brazil.

vocabulary.definition: A type of flat fish, often used in cooking.
examples: Sole is a delicious fish.
I cooked sole with lemon sauce.

vocabulary.definition: To cause someone to feel frightened.
examples: The loud noise scared me.
I didn’t mean to scare him.
The movie was really scary.
That was a scary experience!
Cunha is located on the top of a mountain range.
The mountain range is beautiful during sunrise.

vocabulary.definition: A cascade of water falling from a height.
examples: We visited a stunning waterfall.
The sound of the waterfall is relaxing.

vocabulary.definition: A room in a house for general family use.
examples: We sat in the living room and watched TV.
The living room is spacious.

vocabulary.definition: A large outdoor fire, often used for celebrations.
examples: We gathered around the bonfire.
The bonfire kept us warm during the night.

grammar.explanation: Used to describe actions or events that happened and were completed in the past.
rules: Regular verbs add '-ed' for the past form.
Irregular verbs have unique past forms.
examples: I drank half a bottle. (Eu bebi metade de uma garrafa.)
My car was parked across from the park. (Meu carro estava estacionado do outro lado do parque.)
commonMistakes: Using present tense instead of past tense (e.g., 'I drink' instead of 'I drank').
Incorrect conjugation of irregular verbs (e.g., 'drived' instead of 'drove').

expressions.usage: Used to refer to focusing your sight on something.
examples: Look at the sky.
She looked at the painting for hours.

expressions.usage: Used to describe actions following the consumption of a beverage.
examples: After drinking, he felt sleepy.
I went for a walk after drinking coffee.

practiceQuestions.question: Conjugue o verbo 'eat' no passado.
practiceQuestions.explanation: 'Eat' é um verbo irregular cujo passado é 'ate'.

practiceQuestions.question: Traduza: 'My car was parked across from the park.'
practiceQuestions.answer: Meu carro estava estacionado do outro lado do parque.
practiceQuestions.explanation: A frase usa o passado simples para descrever uma ação completada no passado.

culturalNotes: Cunha é uma cidade brasileira situada em uma serra, famosa por sua tranquilidade.
Paraty é um destino turístico popular no Brasil, conhecido por suas praias e arquitetura colonial.
studyTips: Pratique os verbos irregulares dizendo suas formas no presente e no passado.
Utilize os exemplos fornecidos para criar frases próprias e fixar o vocabulário.
originalExamples: One of my sons is 20 years old. (Um dos meus filhos tem 20 anos.)
My car was parked across from the park. My son crossed the street and I got scared. (Meu carro estava estacionado do outro lado do parque. Meu filho atravessou a rua e eu fiquei assustado.)
I drank half a bottle. (Eu bebi metade de uma garrafa.)
After drinking, I shared the story. (Depois de beber, eu compartilhei a história.)

warnings: practiceQuestions tem apenas 2 item(ns), recomendado mínimo de 3
